title: Come build the next Brex.
summary: Build at Brex with startup speed and ownership, backed by Capital One’s scale. Our best days are still ahead. Come build the next Brex with us.
body_markdown:
The next few years are going to be the most exciting in Brex’s history. I’ve been spending a lot of time talking to candidates about what it means to join us now that we’re part of Capital One, and I want to share why I’m so excited about the answer.


We have the chance to bring what we’ve built to millions of businesses and create products we couldn’t have imagined when we started. I’m as committed to building this company as I’ve ever been, and the people joining us now will help shape what comes next.


## What we will build with Capital One


Capital One has spent decades using technology and data to create better financial products for customers. We share that belief in what technology can make possible. Now we get to bring Brex’s technology and experience building for businesses together with Capital One’s credit expertise, financial strength, and relationships with customers across the country.


That combination opens up a much bigger future for Brex. We can develop products that connect the financial resources a business needs with the software it uses to put those resources to work. We can introduce those products to customers we couldn’t have reached on our own and invest in making them better over many years.


**Our ambition is for every business in the country to reach new levels of growth they never thought possible, built on Brex.** That means helping a founder get a company off the ground, giving an owner the financial flexibility to open another location, or helping a team put more of its energy into developing its next product. There are millions of businesses with people who have something they want to accomplish. We have an opportunity to build products that help them do it.


We can connect access to credit with the tools a business uses to decide how to spend, manage payments, and understand where its money is going. As we build more AI into that experience, we can help finance teams handle more of the work and make better decisions about what comes next.


For me, that makes the next several years incredibly compelling. There are products we can build together that bring a much more complete set of capabilities to businesses, and we’re only beginning to work through what they could become.


## How we build at Brex


Brex remains founder-led, with a relatively small team and leaders who are involved in the details. We expect people at every level to understand the customer, challenge assumptions, and make decisions about how to solve problems. If you join us, you’ll help shape the work and take responsibility for the outcome.


That ownership starts with understanding what needs to change. An engineer can help define the problem as well as build the solution. A marketer can help decide how we introduce Brex to a new audience, develop the story, and see it through to the campaign. Across the company, we want people who bring a point of view and stay close enough to the work to make it better.


Capital One gives us more to work with: financial capabilities, customer relationships, and expertise that expand what our teams can take on. You’ll be working alongside founders and leaders at Brex while learning from people who understand credit, banking, and what it takes to serve customers at a much larger scale. Our responsibility is to turn those capabilities into products and experiences customers can depend on.


You can already see how we approach that work. We continue to ship products monthly or faster, including AI agents across finance workflows. When the infrastructure we need doesn’t exist, we build it ourselves and share work like CrabTrap with the open-source community. Our creative and marketing teams are taking Brex to new audiences through our campaign with Mastercard and Messi, Formula 1 events, and Capital One Arena.


One senior leader who recently joined described an “unusually high concentration of ambitious, curious, low ego people who want to build.” I care a lot about that combination. The opportunity ahead asks us to learn quickly, push each other’s thinking, and take responsibility for making our ideas work. Those are the people I want to keep building Brex with.


## Come build it with us


We’re investing in the team to make all of this happen. We plan to grow significantly in 2027, expand our offices in San Francisco and Seattle, and move into a new flagship office in New York City in the spring. AI is expanding what we can build, and we need more people to pursue the ideas it makes possible. Capital One’s backing lets us invest in those people and products with a longer view of what Brex can become.


When I think about the next several years, I think about the businesses we could help get started, the companies we could help grow, and the people here who will make that happen. I want us to look back and see that we took full advantage of this opportunity. We have the technology, the financial capabilities, and the reach to attempt things we couldn’t have done on our own.


If you’re deciding where to spend the next era of your career, I hope you’ll take a close look at what we’re building. There is so much ahead of us, and I firmly believe some of the best work of our lives is still to come.


[Come build the next Brex with me.](https://www.brex.com/careers)


Pedro
